source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]! I’m preparing a response to an RFQ that is separate from the Tpec project. It appears fairly straightforward and will involve combining all content into one document, creating the layout, org. chart, and budget sheet, and handling the formatting. The response deadline is 7/31, although I plan to submit it on 7/30. Would you be interested in assisting me with this? If yes, could you quote the total cost? I’ll also send the RFQ shortly for your reference. Thanks!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Unfortunately, that exceeds my budget and seems broader in scope than I need. Could we develop a more straightforward option? I’m envisioning one formatting/layout pass on the final draft using GreenLatinos' existing brand colors and fonts, one revision round, and delivery as a print-ready PDF. More specifically, I think I need 1) layout and graphic treatment for the entire document and 2) incorporation of tables/photos/org chart/graphics into the final draft. I’m also assuming an RFP could potentially follow later, since the RFQ is typically the first step. What would this revised option cost?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I need to swap out two of the proposal’s tables, and I’m sorry for the change. The replacements are in this document. Hopefully, you haven’t reached that portion of the layout yet; if you have, I hope replacing the two tables won’t create too much inconvenience. Thank you. [URL_005]

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: [FREELANCER_NAME_001] - Unfortunately, it became necessary to add two rows per phase to the Payment and Milestone Schedule table. I placed the updated table in the Google doc that was shared earlier today. I’m unsure whether it will be simpler for you to add two rows per phase for the new additions or replace the entire table. When you reach this revision, please let me know if you have any questions. Thanks.
